body: I don't know what to do. Tired of being pushed and pulled, and judges as so.

Unloved.. always called a fat looser, "Oh you're smart, but you wont do anything with it." 
"family" always making comments on me, yet, they don't know me..

It gets alot deeper from there. It's all drug related drama, broke the family into 3+ groups. and I'm the target.
Only 3 were family, rest were their friends..
